title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: One project no longer renames its neighbours
summary: In a workspace holding several projects, one project renaming its catalog silently renamed its neighbours' too.

highlights.title: Catalog Rename Stays In Its Project
highlights.description: A rename declared in one settings.gradle.kts was matched by file name alone, so it applied to every other project in the workspace and silenced hover and Ctrl+click there. Settings now govern only their own directory.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: A catalog rename declared in settings.gradle.kts was matched by file name alone. Every default catalog is called libs.versions.toml, so create("deps") in one project also applied to every other project in the workspace: the neighbour believed its root was deps while its build files write libs, and hover and Ctrl+click went silent across it. A settings file now only governs the catalogs under its own directory, and the nearest one wins when a workspace has both a root settings file and a per project one.
The same rule now applies to the unused dependency scan and to Find Usages from inside the catalog, which shared the file name matching.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: A workspace holding a single project sees no change.
No new commands or settings in this release.
